versions.subject: Create win_security_outlook_remote_file.yml
versions.detection:
regquery:
    EventID:
        - 4656
        - 4663
    ProcessName|endswith: OUTLOOK.EXE
    Accesses|contains: 'Query key value'
    ObjectName|contains:
        - \REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM*Services\WebClient\NetworkProvider
        - \REGISTRY\MACHINE\SYSTEM*Services\LanmanWorkstation\NetworkProvider
    
condition: regquery
versions.spl: EventID IN (4656, 4663) ProcessName="*OUTLOOK.EXE" Accesses="*Query key value*" ObjectName IN ("*\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SYSTEM*Services\\WebClient\\NetworkProvider*", "*\\REGISTRY\\MACHINE\\SYSTEM*Services\\LanmanWorkstation\\NetworkProvider*")
